description: This Java class, SimpleFtpClient, provides an implementation of FTP operations such as connect, list files, set transfer modes, upload files, and disconnect. It interacts with an FTP server using the Apache Commons Net library.
external_methods: UtilProperties.getMessage(String propertyFile, String key, Locale locale)

classes.name: SimpleFtpClient
classes.description: A class implementing FTP client functionality, including connecting, listing files, setting transfer modes, copying files, and closing the connection. Implements the FtpClientInterface.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an FTP connection to the specified server with optional port and timeout parameters, performing login verification.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of filenames in the specified directory on the FTP server.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Sets the file transfer mode to binary or ASCII.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Switches between passive and active FTP modes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Uploads a file to the FTP server at the specified path.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the FTP connection if it is currently connected.
